title: Foreign LLC qualification, per jurisdiction
description: DRAFT - the starting contract, expected to change while the pilot runs. Records what it costs and what it takes to register an existing LLC from another state: the registration fee on the common filing path, the official form, the agency that takes the filing, and ongoing obligations as prose. This namespace is authoritative for the foreign registration fee and form; registered-agent eligibility rules live in agent-rules.

registrationFeeUsd.description: Real out-of-pocket cost on the common filing path (online or paper); feeBasis names the path and any gap from the statutory figure.

feeBasis.description: What the figure covers: statutory fee, total cost on the common path, online vs paper difference, processor surcharge.

formName.description: The official form's name or number, verbatim (for example 'Application for Registration (Form LLC-5)').

formUrl.description: The official form page or fee schedule the form and fee were read from.

filedWith.description: The agency that takes the filing, verbatim.

ongoingObligationsNote.description: One short sentence: what the LLC must do after registering, such as an annual report, agent maintenance or recurring fees. Registered-agent eligibility rules themselves live in agent-rules.

notes.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying: definitional calls, excluded costs, boundary cases.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.

supports.description: Which value in the enclosing object this passage grounds, by field name (registrationFeeUsd, formName, ...). A record carrying several passages is only honest if each one says what it is evidence for.
